QuestInfo.name: Just For You 3
QuestInfo.0: Silver wants to thank you for rescuing Moonbeam from the tigers. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Silver was very thankful and said he feels like you are a part of their family. They prepared yet another special gift in your house. The words special gift no longer have the same meaning to you, and you shudder uncontrollably. Go to your house to check out the gift.
QuestInfo.2: After Moonbeam's rescue, all the Pointy-Ear Foxes are acknowledging you as one of their own and gave you a medal for it. These feelings are so strange, much different from getting liver.

0.1: We did acknowledge you as a fox, but to tell you the truth, we still thought of you as an outsider. I know that must be a shock to you, but this time I promise it's different. You really...feel like my own kit. Part of my family.
0.3: You'll be amazed, I'm sure. The gift is at your house, so go on.

0.msg: I should really prepare myself for this one. I can't bear to imagine how shocking it will be...

no.0: No? You're blushing, you know. You really don't need to say no. We want to thank you.

0.0: Those rowdy tigers from over the hills come to our village once in a while to steal a bride. It's always a pain dealing with the beasts we don't usually eat. If it weren't for you, things might not have turned out so well. Thank you so much. I scolded Moonbeam, which should keep her out of trouble for all of five minutes.
0.2: #eThat is why...\r#n\nWe prepared you a very special gift! I also helped this time. This is something totally different from your previous gifts, so I'm SURE you'll just love it.

default.0: It is on a whole new level of gifts. Mm-hmm, that's right.
